messages.en: I'm just at home on my own tonight.
Want me to come over and keep you company? I've finished work.
There's an armed guard at that entrance, right?
Yeah, just show the guard your pass if you want to go in.

collocations.en: have fun at a theme park

messages.en: Let's go have some fun at the beach this weekend!
Let's do it! I haven't been to the beach in ages.
I agree with your suggestion. Let's just do it on Saturday, then.
Okay, I'll check with the others first.
